about.title: A student space to learn and innovate
about.p1: The Embedded Artificial Intelligence club is a university space for students passionate about AI, embedded systems and technology, learning together and turning ideas into concrete projects.
about.p2: We believe technical skill is built through practice and collaboration. That is why we run workshops, training sessions and meetups, and support students from idea to prototype.

privacy.metaTitle: Privacy policy — Embedded Artificial Intelligence club
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How we collect, use and protect your personal data, and what your rights are.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: This site is run by the “Intelligence Artificielle Embarquée” (IAE) club. The club board is responsible for processing the personal data described on this page.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: When you request membership: name, phone, email, class year, track and an optional message. When you complete the membership form through your personal link: the additional information requested, your photo and, if you choose, a photo of your national ID card. Through the contact form: name, email and message. The site uses no advertising trackers; the font is loaded from Google Fonts.

sections.title: Why we use it
sections.body: To review and answer membership requests, manage membership and the annual fee, organise club activities and reply to your messages. We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for marketing.

sections.title: Who can see it
sections.body: Only authorised club officers, according to their role. Attached documents (photo, national ID) are stored in a private, unpublished space and every access is logged. The public site shows only members’ name, photo, class year, track, university and profession.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: We keep data as long as it is needed to review your request or manage your membership. You can ask for it to be deleted at any time.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, object to the processing of, and request deletion of your data, under Moroccan Law 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data; you may also contact the CNDP. To exercise your rights, contact us through the contact form on the home page.

sections.title: Updates to this policy
sections.body: We may change this page when our practices change; the last-updated date is shown at the top.
